description: Work-package fragnet templates: the activities, logic (FS/SS/FF with lag), durations, materials and quality hold points the deterministic engine instances. This is the structure the admin fragnet editor exposes for editing (ADMIN_SPEC.md section 2). The LLM never emits these - it selects and reasons over them, and the engine instances them (CLAUDE.md rule 2).
provenance_summary: MIXED. The stage / owning department / key materials / key gates structure is transcribed from the DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 3 table. The ACTIVITY BREAKDOWNS, DURATIONS, LOGIC LINKS and LAGS are INDUSTRY ESTIMATES sized for a 20 MW-class Tier III build - typical sequences in the right range, not a record of how any project ran. A fragnet whose durations and logic are wrong produces a schedule that is internally consistent and completely wrong, which is harder to catch than an obvious error. This is a starter set establishing the shape; full discipline and commissioning depth is scheduled work, and the real depth should come from the client's historical schedules.

activities.name: Louvres, external doors and glazed openings
Fire-stopping and compartmentation to envelope penetrations

provenance.note: INVENTED FOR REVIEW. Stage, owning department, materials (blocks, waterproofing, cladding) and the two gates (fire-rating, warranties) are transcribed from docs/DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#3. The SIX ACTIVITIES, their SIX DURATIONS, the SIX LOGIC LINKS and the TWO HOLD POINTS are estimates sized for a 20-30 MW-class build: roughly 103 days on the longest path (blockwork -> cladding -> openings -> fire-stopping -> water-tightness). JUDGEMENTS TO CHALLENGE: the SS+15 from blockwork to roofing assumes the frame is topped out and edge details can start once perimeter walls are part-built; the SS+10 from cladding to openings assumes openings follow the cladding gang around the building rather than waiting for it. NOT MODELLED: envelope is treated as one whole-building package, so a phased build that encloses one hall at a time is not represented - that needs a per-zone sub-network which does not exist yet. Fire-stopping is placed here as a QA/QC hold, not as a Tier-1 safety activity; it gates the fire NOC but is not itself a live-energy or life-safety operation.
provenance.warning: INDUSTRY ESTIMATE, NOT A PROJECT ACTUAL. A defensible typical figure for the Indian DC market, standing in until real execution data is loaded. No project ran to this number. Must be verified before use in a live plan.

entries.name: Fire detection, gas suppression and BMS

activities.name: Fire detection and VESDA aspiration pipework
Gas suppression cylinder banks and discharge pipework
BMS field devices, controllers and panel installation

hold_points.name: Gas suppression room integrity (door fan) test
Fire alarm cause-and-effect witnessed for fire NOC

provenance.note: INVENTED FOR REVIEW. Stage, owning department (subcontract), materials (suppression, VESDA, BMS) and the two gates (fire NOC, NBC 2016) are transcribed from docs/DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#3. The SIX ACTIVITIES, their SIX DURATIONS, the SEVEN LOGIC LINKS and the TWO HOLD POINTS are estimates: roughly 73 days on the longest path (detection -> BMS field -> head-end -> cause-and-effect). GROUNDED: the material link from the cylinder banks to lead.gas_suppression is real - the 16-week lead time in equipment_lead_times.json gates that activity, so suppression cannot start before the cylinders land. The safety_ref to safety.gas_suppression_discharge is also real and makes discharge testing a Tier-1 activity requiring sign-off. JUDGEMENTS TO CHALLENGE: cause-and-effect is modelled as one 15-day activity gating the fire NOC, where a real programme often runs it per-zone and re-tests; the three SS overlaps off detection assume one subcontractor sequencing gangs through the building rather than three independent trades. NOT MODELLED: the fire officer witnessing is a hold point, not a statutory pathway activity - the NOC itself lives in the city pathway data.
provenance.warning: INDUSTRY ESTIMATE, NOT A PROJECT ACTUAL. A defensible typical figure for the Indian DC market, standing in until real execution data is loaded. No project ran to this number. Must be verified before use in a live plan.

provenance.note: INVENTED FOR REVIEW. Stage, owning department, materials (containment, structured cabling) and the TIA-942 gate are transcribed from docs/DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#3. The SIX ACTIVITIES, their SIX DURATIONS, the SIX LOGIC LINKS and the TWO HOLD POINTS are estimates sized for a 20-30 MW-class build: roughly 120 days on the longest path (raised floor -> containment -> backbone -> horizontal -> certification). JUDGEMENTS TO CHALLENGE: racks are placed after the raised floor and in parallel with the backbone, which assumes the floor carries the racks - a slab-mounted rack layout would reorder this; the SS+10 from floor to containment assumes containment follows the floor gang across the hall. NOT MODELLED: no material link to a long-lead item, because racks and cabling are not in equipment_lead_times.json - on a real project client-supplied racks are frequently the constraint here and their absence understates this stage. Also not modelled: fit-out is one whole-building package, so a hall-by-hall handover sequence is not represented.
provenance.warning: INDUSTRY ESTIMATE, NOT A PROJECT ACTUAL. A defensible typical figure for the Indian DC market, standing in until real execution data is loaded. No project ran to this number. Must be verified before use in a live plan.
